translation.name: Suha' Maseho: Kadadiam anna Pa'dandiam Bakahu

content: To manontom umpassam kamadahhaam la ullambi' kapataloam
O änä'ku, iam too kasuhunganna anna la umpomatoto'ungko penabammu umpolalam mana' pa'kamasena talambi' illaam Kristus Yesus.
Anna ingganna pepa'guhuam indo puha kutulasangko nasa'bii tau buda, la umpapassanni lako muane to la mala dihannuam umpatudu tau senga'.
La umpendudungko duka' kamadahhaam susi mesa sohodadunna Kristus Yesus to si manuhu'.
Mesa sohodadu mahassam umpalako pengkähängam dipapassanniam tä' si umpikki' kähängam senga' anna mala tiala inabanna punggabana.
Susi siam duka' mesa to illaam passitendeam, tä' mala ullambi' songko' kapataloam ke tä'i untuhu'i si'da-si'da indo la sipäto'na la dipogau' illaam passitendeam.
Mesa to ungkähä litä' ke muasai pala'na mengkähä, pahallu ia siam duka' yolo muala bua pengkähäna.
Paillaam penabai ingganna tula'ku, aka Debata la umpomasiäsangko illaam pikkihammu ingganna inde kaha-kaha.
Pengkilalai Yesus Kristus to puha dipatibangom dio mai alla'na to mate, pessubunna Daud. Iam too Kaheba Katilallasam kupalambi'.
Aka indom too umpa'pakahebaannä' Kaheba Katilallasam nasuhum nalambi'ä' kamapi'disam, la'bi-la'binna disäke'ä' susi tau kadake. Sapo' Battakadanna Puang Allataala tä' ia mala disäke'.

Iam too anna sa'baha'mä' illaam ingganna inde kaha-kaha kusi'dim aka kuua anna mala indo to napilei Puang Allataala ullambi' ia duka' kasalamasam illaam Kristus Yesus sola kamatandeam kakuasaanna sule lako salako-lakona.
Iam too inde kada tadibala'i naua:

content.text: iya la tubokia' duka' sola Kristus.
iya la malakia' ma'pahenta sola Kristus Yesus.
la tontä liu Ia manontom, aka tä' Ia mala tala umponnoi pa'dandianna.

content: La sihatanna napogau' to mengkähä mapianna Puang Allataala
Pa'pakilalaam liui ingganna inde kaha-kaha lako jumaa'. Pakainga'i dio olona Puang Allataala indana ussipengka-pengkai liui tula'. Aka tä' keguna anna anggam umbaba bulim to umpehingngii.
Peäi lalanna anna iannapi anna ia la umpepa'guhuam indo kaheba kamaloloam buttu yabo mai Puang Allataala anna mala naangga'ko mesa to mengkähä mapianna, tala masihi' dio olona.
Pasikambelai kalemu tula' takeguna anna tää'na situhu' pa'elo'na Debata, aka tula' ia too tuttuam umpakende' mandi gau' tala situhu'na pa'elo'na Puang Allataala.
Indo tula' ia too paleleam sihhapam saki kahha'. Anna indo to si umpepa'guhuanni mentamam duka' Himeneus anna Filetus.
Anna inde to dua umpelleim ia lalam kamaloloam aka naua ia: “Puham katibangonganna sule to mate,” nasuhum ungkadakei kamatappasanna sanaka-naka tau.

Sapo' inde ia umma'na Puang Allataala napadadi longkahhim matoto' tatilenggu' anna tatigesse anna nasuha' yabona naua: “Naissam Debata mennanna umma'na,” anna “Menna-menna muakui Debata la umpasikambela ia kalena kakadakeam.”

Mesa banua kasalle tä' anggam pangkakka' bulabam sola peha' illaam, sapo' deem duka' pangkakka' kaju sola litä'. Pangkakka' bulabam sola peha' dipake untammu to kasalle, anna pangkakka' kaju sola litä' dipake allo-allo.
Mesa tau ke umpasikambelai kalena kakadakeam la mendadi pangkakka' kasalle gunana, to dipasähä', anna keguna lako Puäta, anna la malam ungkähä ingganna pengkähängam mapia.

Pasikambelai kalemu kamohäeam sugali' susi si bassa' natuhu'i to mangnguha. Sapo' la umpeä lalanna anna deenni illaam kalemu kamaloloam penaba, kamatappasam, pa'kamase, anna kasiolaam. La umpateem solakoa' ingganna tau to mengkaala längäm Debata sola penaba mahändä.
Anna la umpasikambela kalemu tula' kasipengkaam takeguna si napogau' to tamuissam kalembasanna tula'na. Aka muissam muua umpakende' mandi passikallaam.
Anu' mesa sabua'na Debata tä' la mala massikalla, sapo' la malute lako ingganna tau, manähä umbaba pepa'guhuam, anna mahamme'.

La ma'penaba malunä' umpepatuduam ingganna pa'palakoam mapia lako to pabali-bali, umba-umba aka nagaha' Puang Allataala anna mala la untihokongam gau' nasala, nasuhum la mala muissam lalam kamaloloam.
Lambi' kilala anna lappa' illaam mai pa'pemäläanna tomahajanna setam, aka puham nasakka anna umpassai indo to pabali-bali napalako pa'elo'na.
